newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BRIDGESTONE SAYS LOCAL MARKET IS TOUGH.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BRIDGESTONE SAYS LOCAL MARKET IS TOUGH.

text.p: Tyre maker Bridgestone Australia Ltd said on Thursday its fall in first half earnings was due to softer market conditions but it was well positioned to take advantage of any general economic improvement.

The company, which is 60 percent-owned by Japan's Bridgestone Corp, said net profit in the six months to June 30 fell by 12.6 percent to A$5.27 million, citing reduced sales revenue and continuing pressure on profits.
"As in 1996, gross profits continue to be eroded by cost increases while selling prices remain static or have fallen," it said.
